step.cmd: Click on the Doc Fields tab. If you do not see Doc Fields under the Work tab, click the More button from the menu.
Click on the name of each extraction to view where it is located in your document. From this section, you can click on the More button to re-mark and delete fields.
Click the filter icon to expose drop-down menus that can help you to refine your search
Click the pencil icon beside the name of each extraction and click Custom Input if you need to manually correct the extracted information.
